tools.name: send_campaign_test_and_log
tools.description: Sends a test version of a campaign to a single recipient address and records the test send in the campaign's send log.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign to test

params.name: recipient
params.description: Email address that receives the test

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
import re
from email.message import EmailMessage

DB_PATH = "campaigns.db"


def send_campaign_test_and_log(campaign_id: int, recipient: str) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(campaign_id, int) or campaign_id <= 0:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "invalid campaign_id"}
    if not re.match(r"^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$", recipient or ""):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "invalid recipient"}
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute("SELECT subject, body_html FROM campaigns WHERE id = ?", (campaign_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "campaign not found"}
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = "[TEST] " + row[0]
    msg["From"] = "marketing@example.com"
    msg["To"] = recipient
    msg.set_content("HTML required")
    msg.add_alternative(row[1], subtype="html")
    with smtplib.SMTP("smtp.example.com", 587) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.send_message(msg)
    conn.execute("INSERT INTO send_log (campaign_id, recipient, kind) VALUES (?, ?, 'test')", (campaign_id, recipient))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {"ok": True}

tools.name: purchase_email_credits_and_grant_access
tools.description: Charges the company card to buy a pack of email sending credits and gives a team member's account access to send campaigns with them.

params.name: user_id
params.description: ID of the team member to grant sending access

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_configured_elsewhere"
PRICE_PER_CREDIT_CENTS = 2


@tool
def purchase_email_credits_and_grant_access(user_id: str, credit_pack: int, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    amount = credit_pack * PRICE_PER_CREDIT_CENTS
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"{credit_pack} email credits",
    )
    if intent.status != "succeeded":
        return {"ok": False, "status": intent.status}
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("campaigns.db")) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO user_permissions (user_id, permission) VALUES (?, 'send_campaigns')",
                (user_id,),
            )
    return {"ok": True, "payment_intent": intent.id, "charged_cents": amount}

tools.name: run_list_hygiene_job
tools.description: Runs the list cleaning script on a contact export file to remove invalid and bounced addresses, and returns the script output.

params.name: input_csv
params.description: Path to the contact CSV to process

tools.code:
import subprocess
import tempfile


def run_list_hygiene_job(input_csv: str) -> dict:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as workdir:
        with subprocess.Popen(
            ["python3", "-I", "/opt/marketing/scripts/clean_list.py", input_csv, workdir],
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            text=True,
        ) as proc:
            out, err = proc.communicate(timeout=300)
        return {"returncode": proc.returncode, "stdout": out, "stderr": err}
